```{r, eval=TRUE, echo = F, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
##### Function for water year:
# fxn for water year
water_year <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%
    mutate(WaterYear = if_else(month(date) >= 10, year(date) + 1, year(date)))
}
```



```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Chem data


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

davis_data <- read.csv(
  "/Users/kellyloria/Documents/DRI/ERDC_Davis_Fire/Raw_data/Davis Rock Scrape Biomass.csv"
) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%y"),

    # Standardize spacing and capitalization
    Site_clean = Site %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower(),

    # Standardized site names
    site_lab = case_when(
      Site_clean == "davis"        ~ "davis",
      Site_clean == "ophir"        ~ "ophir",
      Site_clean == "ophir hw"     ~ "ophir_hw",
      Site_clean == "winters"      ~ "winters_usgs",
      Site_clean == "winters usgs" ~ "winters_usgs",
      Site_clean == "winters up"   ~ "winters_up",
      Site_clean == "browns"       ~ "browns",
      Site_clean == "browns hw"    ~ "browns_hw",
      Site_clean == "browns sub"   ~ "browns_sub",
      Site_clean == "mcgee"        ~ "mcgee_creek",
      Site_clean == "mcgee creek"  ~ "mcgee_creek",
      Site_clean == "mcgee park"   ~ "mcgee_park",
      Site_clean == "mcgee hw"     ~ "mcgee_hw",
      Site_clean == "mcgee 395"    ~ "mcgee_395",
      Site_clean == "hilton"       ~ "hilton",
      Site_clean == "hilton lower" ~ "hilton_lower",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Study location
    loc_lab = case_when(
      site_lab %in% c(
        "davis",
        "browns",
        "browns_hw",
        "browns_sub",
        "ophir",
        "ophir_hw",
        "winters_usgs",
        "winters_up"
      ) ~ "davis",

      site_lab %in% c(
        "hilton",
        "hilton_lower",
        "mcgee_395",
        "mcgee_creek",
        "mcgee_hw",
        "mcgee_park"
      ) ~ "pack",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Burn status
    burn_lab = case_when(
      site_lab %in% c(
        "browns",
        "browns_hw",
        "browns_sub",
        "mcgee_395",
        "mcgee_creek",
        "winters_usgs",
        "winters_up"
      ) ~ "burned",

      site_lab %in% c(
        "hilton",
        "hilton_lower",
        "mcgee_hw",
        "ophir",
        "ophir_hw"
      ) ~ "unburned",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Site_clean)

names(davis_data)
str(davis_data)

```

### Collective site algal biomass 

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=3}

library(ggplot2)

p1 <- davis_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site_lab,
             y = AFDM.g.cm..2)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = site_lab), alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = site_lab),
    alpha = 0.8,
    size = 2,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.1),
    shape = 19
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  labs(
    y = expression("Algal biomass (g cm"^{-2}*")"),
    x = NULL
  ) +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  theme_minimal()

p1

```



```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

davis_dat <- davis_data %>%
  group_by(site_lab, loc_lab, burn_lab, date) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(AFDM.g.cm..2)),
    mean_bm_gcm2 = round(mean(AFDM.g.cm..2, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    se_bm = round(sd(AFDM.g.cm..2, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```


### Mean and standard deviation of agal biomass on rocks each reach per visit. 

August to October 2025

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}

# Plot means ± SD
p2 <- davis_dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean_bm_gcm2, color = site_lab, group = site_lab)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_bm_gcm2 - se_bm, ymax = mean_bm_gcm2 + se_bm),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = site_lab_colors) +
  labs(
    y ="Algal biomass (g cm^-2)",
    x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
   facet_grid(loc_lab ~.)

p2

```



```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}

# Plot means ± SD
p2 <- davis_dat %>%
  filter(loc_lab=="davis",!site_lab %in% c("ophir_hw", "browns_hw", "winters_usgs"))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean_bm_gcm2, color = site_lab, group = site_lab, shape = burn_lab)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_bm_gcm2 - se_bm, ymax = mean_bm_gcm2 + se_bm),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = site_lab_colors) +
  labs(
    y ="Algal biomass (g cm^-2)",
    x = NULL) +
        scale_x_date(limits = c(as.Date("2025-08-01"), as.Date("2026-05-25")),
        date_breaks = "2 month", date_labels = "%b-%y") +
  theme_minimal() 

p2


p3 <- davis_dat %>%
  filter(
    loc_lab == "davis",
    !site_lab %in% c("ophir_hw", "browns_hw", "winters_usgs")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = mean_bm_gcm2,
      color = site_lab,
      group = site_lab,
      shape = burn_lab
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_bm_gcm2 - se_bm,
      ymax = mean_bm_gcm2 + se_bm
    ),
    alpha=0.8,
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha=0.8) +
  
  # Site colors + clean legend labels
  scale_color_manual(
    values = site_lab_colors,
    labels = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  ) +
  
  # Clean burn-status labels
  scale_shape_discrete(
    labels = function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    y = expression("Algal biomass (g cm"^{-2}*")"),
    x = NULL,
    color = "Site",
    shape = "Burn status"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(as.Date("2025-08-15"), as.Date("2026-05-15")),
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b-%y"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )

p3

```
